name: Coastal CSG Battle: Philippine Sea
description: Three-hour fictional CSG game east of Taiwan. Same combat forces and 160nm separation as csg_grand_battle; every initial position and mission point translated +100nm east/+100nm north on the 118E/18N,24N chart. Charted land blocks movement; navigation routes avoid islands. Satellite imagery is an August 2004 composite, not live intelligence. Weighted kills: ship10/sub5/air1. Coastal variant replaces two Ford F/A-18E with two EA-18G ALQ-99J fits to exercise electronic support; total ready aircraft count is unchanged. J-15D and its pod fit retain source-estimated status.

theater.attribution: NASA GIBS / MODIS / NASA Earth Observatory

terrain.source: Natural Earth land 5.1.1, 1:10 million, public domain; chart guard only, no bathymetry/elevation
